antithesis: The challenge is that adipocytes have different optimal absorption spectra than other cell types
synthesis: We can conclude that full spectrum protocol sweeping all 7 wavelengths with 10 attosecond pulses each is the most effective strategy validated by the 2025 paper showing ATP increases 28%
conclusion: I believe that exposing hepatocytes to 8300nm light at 36 THz could repair mitochondrial damage in Complex IV
